comparison.objective: Fit a long server bezel by seating right tabs and engaging a left spring latch; candidate screens ceramic media from steel washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part alignment, asymmetric hook-and-pivot insertion, and latch force control versus symmetric tab load sharing, screen tilting/agitation, and particle retention.
comparison.success_condition: Tabs seated, bezel flush, latch overlapped, low force and released rest versus recovery fraction, all washers retained, no spill/damage, dual support, clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both include tabs and bimanual handling, but the tabs serve different functions: bezel attachment versus grasp points for dynamic selective separation. Missing rubric details: none material.
